questions.question: What did the man clothed in linen do in chapter 9?
options: Put a mark on those who grieved over the sin
Anointed a new high priest for the holy temple
Read the law aloud to all the people
Sealed the temple gates against the enemy
questions.answer: Put a mark on those who grieved over the sin

questions.question: Who were spared in the slaughter that followed?
options: Those who paid tribute to the king
Those who were priests serving in the temple
Those with the mark on their foreheads
Those who fled the city before the siege
questions.answer: Those with the mark on their foreheads

questions.question: The executioners were told to begin at God's sanctuary, with the elders.
